about: The ONE list of email categories a reader can turn off and back on. Fetched by marketing/preferences/index.html (the toggles) and marketing/unsubscribe/index.html (the confirm wording). Each key is the eventKey / prefKey a sender writes into its unsubscribe link and checks with is_email_unsubscribed. scripts/validate-w5-push-unsub-keys.ts fails when a sender uses a key that is neither here nor on its exclusion list. daily_digest is not listed on purpose: it is managed in the app (Settings -> Push & email preferences), where its truth lives.

documents.about: Documents a contractor sends his own client or sub directly (send-email). They are transactional and no sender checks an unsubscribe before sending them, so neither page offers a switch for them: the preferences page says an earlier unsubscribe doesn't affect them, and the unsubscribe page says so instead of confirming. Same keys as TRANSACTIONAL_DOCUMENT_KEYS in supabase/functions/_shared/email.ts (scripts/validate-w5-push-unsub-keys.ts checks the two match).
